page_title: GEN 2-1 ROM | Genoa v AS Roma 08/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' A quickly taken corner by Genoa.

90+1' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Mile Svilar anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target. The ball is out of play. Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) is about to take a corner kick.
90' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Now AS Roma have a corner.
89' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
84' Substitution. Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma) in, Gianluca Mancini out.
84' Substitution. Zeki Celik leaves the pitch and is replaced by Robinio Vaz (AS Roma).
80' 2 - 1 Goal! Patrizio Masini manages to prod the ball to Vitinha (Genoa) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball low into the middle of the goal. 2:1.
79' Daniele De Rossi is forced to make a change. Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) is unable to continue due to injury, Aaron Martin comes on.
78' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
75' Substitution. Caleb Ekuban makes his way off the pitch and Vitinha (Genoa) comes on as his replacement.
74' The corner from Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) is cleared away by the defence.
73' Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. AS Roma win a corner.
70' The corner is swung in but Genoa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

70' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. The ball goes behind for a corner. Genoa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Devyne Rensch will be replaced by Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma).
64' Daniele De Rossi has decided to substitute Junior Messias and he is replaced by Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa).
64' That will be all from Jeff Ekhator who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa).
64' The linesman makes the right call and AS Roma will have a corner.

64' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

61' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Donyell Malen (AS Roma). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
58' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Donyell Malen (AS Roma) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
56' A substitution has been made. Lorenzo Pellegrini goes off and Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) comes on.
55' 1 - 1 Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the left post, and thus alter the score to 1:1.
55' AS Roma will take a corner kick.
53' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well over the bar.
52' 1 - 0 GOAL! Junior Messias (Genoa) takes a real chance, but his penalty strike right into the middle of the net fools Mile Svilar in goal.
52' Junior Messias (Genoa) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
50' Genoa take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
50' The Genoa players keep hold of the ball by exchanging some long passes. One inaccurate pass, however, surrenders possession. It will be a corner kick for Genoa.
49' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
49' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' Substitution. Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) has come on for Lorenzo Venturino.
46' Referee Andrea Colombo blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' A clever short pass gives Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
40' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Donyell Malen (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.
36' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) pounces on a cross into the middle of the box, but plants his header well wide of the right post.
33' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
33' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
30' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Mile Svilar.
29' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Genoa win a free kick.
27' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
26' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) trips an opposition player and Andrea Colombo signals a foul.
24' The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save as he denies the first-time effort by Junior Messias (Genoa) from the edge of the box.
22' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma).
22' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
21' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

21' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Donyell Malen (AS Roma), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
18' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
17' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
16' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
13' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
12' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) sees a yellow card from Andrea Colombo after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
7' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
5' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
